scope: Fresh CPU native-CMB+DESI BAO+released Pantheon+SH0ES inference. The complete anchored SN factor replaces Dovekie; no external H0/Cepheid factor is multiplied in.
accuracy_semantics: The numerical proposal always uses the existing accuracy-one spectral surrogate and background. The declared native target uses all three accuracy controls set to native_accuracy, with lens_potential_accuracy=4 and every physical parameter, prior and likelihood unchanged. Native accuracy two is corrected directly against the proposal, with no intermediate native-one cohort required.
sampler: Unchanged IndependenceMCMC and normalized frozen Gaussian/t5 mixture. A separately verified anchored-bridge-weighted-proposal-v1 or original Dovekie-trained mixture may be used strictly as a proposal; no source-target equality or posterior qualification is inferred from its training data. No adaptation, clipping or target transport.
chain_gates: Unchanged diagnostics.check_mpi, discard0.3, four independent chains, rank-normalized Rhat<=1.01 and bulk/tail ESS>=400 for every nonconstant sampled/declared derived coordinate.
correction_gates: Unchanged exact_correction.summarize and luminosity-sensitivity-design.json overlap_gates. At least2000 stratified untrimmed points, rawESS>=400, each-chainESS>=50, Pareto k<.7, chain weights.05-.5, chain mean discrepancy<=.3SD and batchMCSE<=.1SD. No measurement if any evaluation or gate fails.
runtime: Four MPI ranks, one thread per rank, CPU/NumPy only. Explicit unchanged native_initialize before sampled densities. Correction workers use spawn and verify source snapshots before initialization and every point.
cache: Separate anchored schema and target/correction identities. Full raw record seals, parent chain/diagnostic hashes and live target asset/version checks are mandatory. Generic original-sample consumers must reject these records. No spoofed old manifest and no monkeypatching original globals.
limitations: Released selection/calibration and approximate cross-probe factorization remain assumptions. The improper flat-M measure precludes normalized evidence. Finite diagnostics do not establish unseen-mode coverage or calibrate posterior tail significance. No age correction is measured. Scaffold validation has no observational likelihood/background/spectrum calls; Production launch is separate from scaffold validation and requires the stated prerequisites.
